description: Ignores handheld armor.

name: Saw-me-not
description:
Gains 5 Shield hitpoints every 0.5s, capped at 300.
Damage is split equally between all zombies in range, but can only go as low as 1 damage.

name: Snow Lotus
description:
Gains 1 ice charge every 10s, or when hit by a snowball or snow trident.
Consumes 5 ice charges to heal plants in a 3x3 area for 50 HP.

name: Aloe Aqua
description:
Gains 1 ice charge from snowballs and tridents.
Gains 15 ice charges from Ice-shroom.
Consumes 1 ice charge to thrown an ice chunk, with 200 damage, Deep Chill, and 40 Cryo points.

name: Bamblock
description:
On contact with a zombie, deals damage equal to the zombies health, at the cost of its toughness.
Other plants cannot absorb damage for Bamblocks.
Immune to crush.

name: Frozen Giftbox
description: Spawns a random frozen base plant.

name: Hoarfrost Lichen
description:
Bursts into a ring of 12 snowballs.
Snowballs fired to the left deal 1 damage to plants and Freeze plants in a 3x3 area upon impact.
Snowballs fired to the right (including straight up and down) deal 600 damage to zombies and apply Deep Freeze for 1s.

name: Cattail Girl
description: Prioritizes flying zombies.

name: Swordmaster Starfruit
description: Each attack unleashes 5 swords that pierce infinitely, dealing 200 damage each. Inflicts 600 damages to all zombies within the surrounding tiles.

name: Nyan Squash
description:
Drops itself as a Seed Packet if it doesn't hit anything.
For each zombie hit, drops a Squash Seed Packet, up to 3.
Drops a Spicy Squash Seed Packet if it crushes more than 3 zombies.
Seed packets will not drop in water lanes.

name: Burger Blaster (1-4)
description:
Upgraded by Cactus, then Melon-pult, then Winter Melon to reach higher levels.
Every 300 damage dealt, stops firing for 3s.
Fires random projectiles, including:
- Pea (20 damage)
- Star (20 damage)
- Ignited Pea (40 damage)
- Blazing Pea (50 damage)
- Inferno Pea (50 damage)
- Spore (20 damage)

name: Queen Endoflame
description:
Increases base damage by 25 for each unique Odyssey Plant on the field.
Targets zombies across the screen.
Projectiles return 5 sun on hit and can be upgraded by passing through Squashed Infernowoods for x4 damage and the ability to return 25 sun each.

name: Coldsnap Bean
description: Strengthens Snow shooting plants in a 3x3 area (including its own tile) to launch polar ice peas, tripling cryo points and damage.

name: Amp-nion
description:
Each hit can connect to up to 3 zombies.
When another Electronion is in range, provides an additional 150 damage for this shot.

name: Snipea
description: If fused with a Gatling Pea, creates a Snipea seed-packet.

name: Chrysanctum
description: After 2 seconds, disappears and grants plants in a 3x3 are 6 seconds of immunity to all damage and crushing.

name: Doubleblast Passionfruit
description:
Each hit deals an additional hit equal to 10% of the zombie's max toughness, to the Zombie's Type 1 armor.
Ultimate (Cooldown 2s): Launches a giant passionfruit seed that deals damage to armor equivalent to 20% of current HP.

name: Lucky Blover
description:
When placed, forces your next Plant Giftbox to generate a guaranteed Advanced fusion.
In Odyssey Gacha Mode, it will instead guarantee an Odyssey plant.

name: Plant Giftbox
description:
When placed, produces a random plant.
Placing it on top of an eligible plant can produce a random valid fusion.

name: Endoflame
description: Each projectile reduces toughness by 200 and produces 25 Sun. Produces a Fertilizer upon death or shoveling.

name: Zombie Giftbox
description: Spawns a Golden Mystery-box Zombie, or a Conehead/Buckethead Ducky Tube Zombie in water lanes.

name: Grave Buster
description: Destroys gravestones after 5 seconds.

name: Spikerock

Does not block regular zombies.

name: Barley

name: Cattail
description: Shoots thorns that home in zombies closest to your house. Prioritizes flying zombies.

name: Imitater
description:
Plant Imitater on a plant or fusion to receive a free seed packet of the plant.
Does not copy pots, pads, pumpkins, and drones.

name: Cob Cannon
description:
Must be planted on two horizontally neighboring Kernel-pults.
Click to aim, then Click to fire.

name: Spruce Ballista
description: Bolts pierce up to 2 times (can pierce ice) and explode 0.3s after hitting a zombie, dealing AoE damage in a small area.

name: Jicamagic
description:
Fusion catalyst for Titan plants

name: Obsidian Barley
description: Transforms into a random Ultimate plant every 30s (excluding Avarice-shroom).

name: Diamond-mine
description:
Easter Egg Plant
Anti-crush
Produces 500 points on damage phase transitions and on death.

name: Diamond Imitater
description:
1.5s after appearing, generates a random plant, zombie, or event.
10% chance to generate an Odyssey Plant
50% chance to generate a Giftbox Plant.
10% chance to generate an Odyssey Zombie.
10% chance to generate a Boss, Miniboss, or Odyssey Zombie.
15% chance to generate a common zombie.
5% chance to cause one of the following events:
1. Gain 200 Sun.
2. Acquire an Odyssey Modifier.
3. Instantly kill all zombies within 1.5 tiles of range.
4. Deal 4000 damage to plants in a 3x3 area.
5. Create a column of Fireballs rolling right, inflicting Enflamed and leaving a 40-damage fire trail.

name: Bucket
description:
Can only be placed on the lawn from the seed packet, otherwise it only serves to fuse.
Obtained by killing a Buckshooter Zombie or Buck-nut Zombie without an explosion or Chomper plant.
Also obtained from Magnet-shroom via Bucketheads.

name: Football Helmet
description:
Can only be placed on the lawn from the seed packet, otherwise it only serves to fuse.
Obtained by killing a Football Tall-nut Zombie without an explosion or Chomper.
Also obtained from Magnet-shroom via Football zombies.

name: Hearty Apple
description:
Starts with 0 energy when planted, Max energy is capped at 4000.
Blocks damage for plants in a 3x3 area by consuming energy equal to damage blocked.
Naturally regenerates 1 energy every 0.02s. When damaged or when consuming energy, regeneration is is paused for 1s. When energy is depleted (except when planted), energy regen is paused for 5s.

name: Bamboom
description:
After 1 second, flies forward in its lane, knocking back zombies and causing 300 area damage on each impact.
Deals 15x damage to Nian zombies.

name: Golden Recycling Vase
unlock: Beat Vasebreaker: The Vase Less Traveled by, De-vase-tating! and Potluck.
description:
Can gain up to 3 charges by using the glove to move plants inside. Basic plants grant 1, Basic fusions grant 2, and Advanced fusions grant 3 charges.
Tap to break the vase. Drops a plant seed packet based on stored charges:
1 charge for Basic plants
2 charges for Basic fusions
3+ charges for Advanced fusions.
If an Odyssey plant was stored, it will always drop an Odyssey plant.

name: Signpost Arrow
description: Used in the Zombie Sorter minigame and Super Level Editor for TD Levels.

description:
When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker and summons a 'Solar Comet.' The Solar Comet seeks out zombies (prioritizing hypnotizes zombies) and bounces between them, up to 10 times. When it hits a hypnotized zombie, it deals 200 damage and drops 25 Sun. When it hits a non-hypnotized zombie, it deals 100 damage and drops 15 Sun.
After the Comet completes 10 bounces or disappears, it drops an additional 25 Sun.
The comet cannot bounce off of the same zombie twice.

name: Catalyst-shroom
description: Upon being bitten, turns the zombie into a Hypnotized Explod-o-shooter Zombie and disappears.

name: Hypno-nut
description:
Spawns a Hypnotized Mystery-box zombie every 30s. (or when fertilized)
4% chance on each bite to hypnotize the zombie.
Recovers 100 Toughness when hit by a Trippy-shroom spore, storing one spore of each color each time its hit.
When it collects 7 different spore colors, it consumes them to summon a Hypnotized Golden Mystery Box Zombie, and restores all toughness.

name: Hypno Mine
description:
Hypnotizes all zombies in the explosion range.
If a zombie cannot be hypnotized it deals 1800 damage instead.

name: Hypno Chomper
description:
Also targets Hypnotized zombies and drops a Hypno-shroom seed packet on a successful devour of a Hypnotized zombie, then digests for 10s.
When bitten, it hypnotizes the attacker then reverts to a Chomper.

name: Gnome-shroom
description: When eaten, makes a zombie fight for you, reducing Toughness by 30%.

name: Perfume-shroom
description:
Chance to hypnotize zombies with less that 50% Toughness.
Higher chance the lower the Toughness.
When bitten, hypnotizes the zombie, then reverts to a regular Fume-shroom.

name: Sunny-shroom
description:
Gradually shortens production time to 10s.
Hides when zombies approach, resetting back to 25s and immediately produces 25 Sun.

name: Blasty-shroom
description: When scared, hides and sets off a Cherry Bomb that deals 600 damage in a 3x3 area.

name: Sturdy-shroom
description: After cowering for 10s, immediately stands up and knocks back nearby zombies, dealing 20 damage. For the next 5s, he will not hide himself again. While cowering, takes 50% reduced Damage.

name: Spuddy-shroom
description:
Each attack costs 75 Toughness.
If kept alive for 20s, Attack power reduced by 90% but attacks will no longer cost Toughness.

name: Gutsy-shroom
description: Shoots 2 spores at once. When zombies are within 4 tiles, sprays piercing fumes instead.

name: Trippy-shroom
description:
Randomly fires 1 of 7 types of spores. When a zombie is hit by all 7 types of spores, it will be hypnotized.
Increases the chance Perfume-shroom will hypnotize zombie each time it is hit by a type of spore.
When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker then reverts to a Scaredy-shroom

name: Snow Repeater
description: Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.

name: Split Snow
description:
Peas shot backwards will rebound upon reaching the edge of the screen.
Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.

name: Sundae-shroom
description:
Every time it produces sun, all frozen zombies on the lawn drop 15 sun.
The first two times it produces sun, triggers Ice-shroom effects that inflict Chill but not Freeze. The third time, triggers the full Ice-shroom effect, then disappears.

name: Frozen Cherry
description:
Absorbs cherries for 1 energy points, ignited cherries for 2, and explosive cherries for 10.
A Cherry Bomb seed packet is generated every 100 energy points.
Explodes and Freezes zombies in a 3x3 range on its death.

name: Frost-nut
description: Zombies that bite him are slowed down.

name: Ice Mine
description: On arming and detonation, triggers an ice blast in a 3x3 area, and a second ice blast dealing 1/3rd damage at all zombies damaged by the first ice blast.

name: Frost Tall-nut
description: Heals 1000 Toughness when affected by Ice-shroom.

name: Hail-shroom
description: Freezes zombies that on contact.

name: Cryonic-shroom
description:
Upon contact turns a zombie into a Frost Tall-nut Zombie that will fight for you.
Triggers Ice-shroom effect when eaten.

name: Shivery-shroom
description:
Deals 4x damage to frozen zombies.
Freezes nearby zombies when they get near.

name: Doom Pea
description:
Damage increases by 1 each attack, up to 60.
If a Frenzy-shroom is planted 1 tile behind it, Doom Pea gains Frenzy shroom's attack speed and Frenzy shroom gains Doom Pea's attack damage.

name: Doomflower
description: Every 50s, plants on Doom-spore randomly in a 3x3 area around itself.

name: Black Cherry
description: Triggers a Cherry Bomb explosion when fused, then explodes like a Doom-shroom after 1.5s. The Doom-shroom blast deals 1800 base damage, increasing by 300 for each zombie that was hit by the Cherry Bomb explosion.

name: Doom-nut
description:
Immune to non-physical explosions.
Prevents Doom-shroom Zombies in a 3x3 area from exploding.
Heals for 100 when a zombie with Irradiated debuff dies nearby.
Triggers Doom-shroom effect on death (Spawns a crater).

name: Crater-tot
description: When it triggers, throws 5 "potato chunks" that spawn armed Potato Mine plants on random valid tiles.

name: Doom Chomper
description: On each bite, causes a doom shroom explosion in front of it, leaving a crater. (Does not trigger doom shroom if planted on column 9)

name: Boom-shroom
description: Explodes when zombies get close.

name: Curse-shroom
description:
Upon contact makes a single zombie cursed, and fight for you.
Cursed zombies will cause a Doom-shroom explosion upon death or leaving the lawn.

name: Frenzy-shroom
description:
Each attack will shorten the attack interval by 0.1 seconds, to a minimum of 0.25 seconds. Resets when zombies get near.
Explodes when zombies get near while peak attack speed is reached.
If placed next to Doom Pea, gains Doom Peas damage.

name: Demise-shroom
description:
Freezes surviving zombies for 5s.
Stalls the next zombie wave for 10s.

name: Sunflower Pad
description: Produces a Sunflower every 90 seconds.

name: Nut Pad
description: Produces a Wall-nut every 90 seconds.

name: Pea Squash
description:
Upon landing, releases 3 rings of 36 pea projectiles, for a total of 108 peas.
The Peas fire from the lhe landing point outward, each offset by 10°.

name: Solar Squash
description: Upon landing or dying, consumes (50 + ?, where ? is the number of previous revivals) to remain on the tile of the landing spot. If this fails, 50 Sun is refunded.

name: Cherry Squash
description: Detects zombies 2 tiles to the left and 3 tiles to the right.

name: Squash-nut
description:
Bounces in his tile when a zombie gets close, dealing splash damage on each landing.
Does not block airborne zombies.

name: Potato Masher
description:
Starts out armed by default. When a zombie enters his targeting range, he generates a Potato Mash on the spot, then burrows underground for 15s to arm again.
Potato Mash has the same effect and damage as Squash, but with a larger targeting range.

name: Jawbreaker
description:
On landing, attempts to devour one zombie caught underneath. Still deals damage to zombies that are not eaten.
On a successful devour, returns to the field on the same tile, otherwise he disappears.

name: Squish
description:
Detects 2 tiles to the left and right.
Smashes once every second and does not disappear after smashing. When not targeting, jumps back to its original tile.
Immune to crush. When crushed, takes 500 damage every 0.02s. When smashed, takes damage equal to the corresponding damage a hypnotized zombie would take when smashed.

name: Hypno Squash
description: Hypnotizes the crushed zombies, or deals 1800 damage if the zombie cannot be hypnotized.

name: Icy Squash
description: Freezes crushed zombies, as well as zombies in a 3x3 range, for 4s.

name: Doom Squash
description:
Detects zombies 2 tiles to the left and 3 tiles to the right.
Leaves a crater on landing, destroying all plants on that tile as well.

name: Squash Pad
description: Produces a Squash every 90 seconds.

name: Multipeater
description:
Can swap between three attack modes by being tapped.
Standard mode: Fires 2 peas in its lane and the 2 directly adjacent lanes.
Spread mode: Fires 1 pea in each lane, up to 6 lanes. If there are less than 6 lanes, the damage from the unfired pea is split between the fired peas.
Focus mode: Fires 6 peas in its own lane.

name: Cherry-spreader
description:
Projectiles attach to targets and explode after 6s with a 1-tile splash radius. Each zombie can only have one half-ripe cherry attached.
While attached, half-ripe cherries absorb 25% of all cherry-type projectile and cherry explosion damage the zombie takes, adding that to its final explosion damage.

name: Three-nuts
description:
Each Nut in the stack has 4k HP.
Stage 1 = 12k-8k HP.
Stage 2 = 8k-4k HP.
Stage 3 = 4k-0k HPs.

name: Threetato Mine
description:
Attacks faster as zombies get closer.
Explodes on contact, knocking back surviving zombies 1 tile.
Re-emerges 15s after exploding.
Explodes and disappears upon contact with vehicles.

name: Tripad
description: Produces a Threepeater every 90 seconds.

name: Squash-spreader
description: Every time a mini squash hits the ground, it inflicts 40 points of damage to nearby zombies

name: Tangle-nut
description: When bitten, inflicts 1 Tangle value on the attacker. When crushed, loses 50HP and inflicts 1 Tangle value every 0.02s until dead.

name: Tangle Mine
description:
Ground version of Kelp Mine.
When armed, insta kills the first approaching zombie and triggers a Potato Mine explosion.

name: Kelp Mine
description:
Water version of Tangle Mine.
Insta-kills the first approaching zombie and deals 600 damage to zombies in a 3x3 area.

name: Tingle Kelp
description: When a zombie comes into contact with Tingle Kelp, it will burst into 30 kelp projectiles that inflict 1 Tangle value before disappearing. If a zombie is killed by the kelp projectile, an extra Tingle Kelp will spawn on that tile (if possible).

name: Grapple Kelp
description:
Each of the three tendrils applies a different affect.
The first hit applies one extra Tangle Stack, the second hit deals additional damage equal to 5x(Tangle Stacks), the third hit deals knockback to the zombie.

name: Strangle Kelp
description: Drags three zombies into the water, and also deals 600 damage to nearby zombies on kill.

name: Kelp-spreader
description: Each attack adds 1 Tangled value.

name: Spicicle

Absorbs damage for all plants (unless protected by another unstable jalepeno, or a Giga Mecha/Mecha-nut, Obsidian Tall/Mine-nut).
Triggers Jalapeno and Ice-shroom effects on death.

description:
Does not explode automatically; click manually to trigger a Jalapeno blast and a Doom-shroom explosion.

Instantly kills vehicles and itself.

name: Weed-spreader
description:
Deal 30% maximum Toughness damage to vehicles at the cost of themselves.
Does not block regular zombies.
Instantly kills vehicles and itself.

name: Tangle Weed
description: Attacks add 1 Land Tangle Value (1/3 Tangle Value)

name: Spike Kelp
description:
Takes 10 damage every time he attacks a vehicle.
Attacks add 1 Tangle Value.

name: Scorchweed
description:
Attacks inflict Enflamed Debuff.
Does not block regular zombies.
Instantly kills vehicles and itself.

name: Torchflower
description: Each time she prouces Sun, converts all plant (and hypnotized zombie) projectiles in a 1.5 Tile radius into Sun. (5 per projectile)

name: Boomwood
description:
Generates a homing cherry drone for every 30 peas that pass through.
Converts any explosive cherry that passes through into a cherry drone.
There can be up to 3 cherry drones at once.
Triggers Cherry Bomb explosion on death.

name: Nutwood
description: For every 50 peas lit, a Roasted Wall-nut is spawned in front.

name: Blowtorch-shroom
description:
Does not attack on its own. Absorbs passing peas. Every 1s, exhales a piercing flame 4 tiles forward, with damage equal to the total damage of absorbed peas, up to 300.
Melts Snow Peas into normal peas.

name: Hypnowood
description:
Summons a hypnotized Gatling Pea Zombie for every 60 projectiles ignited. Passing Hypno Peas count as 4 projectiles. When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker and reverets to a Torchwood.
Projectile effects:
Peas: Ignited for +20 damage.
Hypno Peas: Ignited for +30 damage.
Snow Peas: Reverted to Peas.

name: Frostburn-wood
description:
Turns normal peas into snow peas, and snow peas into polar ice peas for 2x damage and cryo points.
Turns flaming peas into normal peas.

name: Doomwood
description:
Behaves as a torchwood when Irradiated value is 0.
When Irradiated value is not 0, turns peas and ignited peas into ember peas, with +30 damage and 1/3 splash damage (stacks with ignited peas), and inflicts Irradiated debuff.
Can use 10 Irradiated values to strengthen Doom peas for x2 or Mini Doom Peas for x6 damage.
Gains 60 Irradiated points per 60 projectiles ignited, 30 from Doom-shroom explosions, and 10 when any zombie within a 5x5 area dies with the Irradiated debuff.

name: Torch Pad
description: Produces a Torchwood every 90 seconds.

name: Squashwood
description: Every 60 peas lit will cause a Fiery Squash to be planted in front.

name: Torchthree
description: Ignites Peas, and spawns ignited peas in the two neighboring lanes.

name: Torch-kelp
description:
Ignites peas and kelp shots for +20 damage.
Ignited kelp shots add 1 Tangled value to all zombies in the splash range.
Every 100 shots lit spawns a Fiery Tangle Kelp in front.

name: Scorchwood
description:
Causes a Jalapeno effect on death.
Ignites peas, ignited peas, and potatoes for +30 damage.

name: Torchweed
description:
Ignites small peas for increased and splashed damage.
Every 100 peas lit spawns a Fieryweed in front.

name: Icerock
description:
Inflicts Chill.
Does not block regular zombies.
Instantly kills vehicles, dealing 50 or more toughness to itself.

name: Hearthrock
description:
Attacks inflict Enflamed Debuff.
Does not block regular zombies.
Instantly kills vehicles, dealing 50 or more toughness to itself.

name: Sea-nut
description:
Grows at 10s and 20s after planting.
Toughness increases by 2000 each growth stage, 2000 → 4000 → 6000
After 30s, turns into a bowling nut, dealing 600 damage on contact

name: Land-mine
description:
Starts armed.
Grows after 30s, then again after another 30s.

name: Sea-mine
description:
Starts armed.
Grows after 30s, then again after another 30s.

name: Minnow-shroom
description:
Starts out as a school of 2, grows into 3 after 15s.
After becoming a school of 3, feeds the plant directly in front with a Sea-shroom every 15s. If impossible, drops a Sea-shroom seed packet.

name: Shark-shroom
description:
Using Sea-shroom seedpacket on it extends its range to the full lane for 10s.
Knocks back zombies koncked back by Leviathan-shroom within the last 3s.

name: Jelly-shroom
description:
After consuming a Sea-shroom seed packet, summons a hypnotized ducky tube zombie (browncoat)
When bitten, hypnotizes the attack then disappears.

name: Hermit-shroom
description:
Hides by default.
Using a Sea-shroom seed packet on him makes him attack for 10s.

name: Swell-shroom
description: Using a Sea-shroom seed packet on him makes him swell up and Freeze all zombies in a 3x3 area, applying Chill and dealing 20 damage.

name: Orca-shroom
description: After consuming a Sea-shroom seed packet, launches a Doom spore that deals 600 damage in a moderate radius after consuming a Sea-shroom. Feeding has no CD, but each shot takes 1.5s to fire and only a max of2 shots can register at the samee time.

name: Beamshooter
description:
Gains Lumos energy equal to its Lumos level every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes (10% of current energy + 1) energy when attacking or transferring.
Can lock onto a Split Beam in front in the same lane (not directly adjacent). Transfers energy every 0.1s, restoring energy equal to 10% of its attack. Each point of energy spent doubles the amount transferred.
Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack 1 zombie, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent.

name: Rebeamer
description:
Gains Lumos energy equal to its Lumos level every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes (10% of current energy + 1) energy when attacking or transferring.
Can lock onto a Split Beam in front in the same lane (not directly adjacent). Transfers energy every 0.1s, restoring energy equal to 20% of its attack. Each point of energy spent doubles the amount transferred.
Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack 2 zombies at once, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent.

name: Split Beam
description: The Beamshooter head functions exactly as a beamshooter, inheriting all of its traits. The left head can receive Lumos energy from beamshooter-family plants in the same lane (not in directly adjacent tiles.)

name: Gatling Beam
description:
Gains Lumos energy equal to its Lumos level every 0.5s, up to 1000. Each laser beam consumes (10% of current energy + 1) energy when attacking or transferring.
Can lock onto a Split Beam in front in the same lane (not directly adjacent). Transfers energy every 0.1s, restoring energy equal to 40% of its attack. Each point of energy spent doubles the amount transferred.
Consumes energy every 0.2s to attack 4 zombies at once, increasing damage by the amount of energy spent.

name: Illumi-nut
description: Provides 1 Lumos Level in a 3x3 Grid. Restores 150 Toughness per Lumos Level every 15s.

name: Lumos Angler
description:
Each Lumos Level reduces digest time by 10s (minimum 10s.)
Upon successful digestion, pulls a nearby zombie from adjacent lanes to its lane.

name: Aurora Plantern
description:
Gives one Lumos Level to a 3x3 area.
Lasers fired by Lumos Cactus turn cyan and gain the ability to apply Chill after passing through this plantern (does not effect flying zombies).

name: Ray-shroom
description:
Each Lumos level increases damage by 50%.
Damage increases by 1.6 x (5 - [column distance to target]), or 0.8 x (10 - [column distance to target]) at Lumos Level 3.

name: Blacklight Plantern
description:
Every 3s, supplies Doomwoods in a 3x3 area with 3 Irradiated value.
Lasers fired by Lumos Cactus turn purple and gain the ability to trigger a 1x1 explosion dealing 10 damage on hit after passing through Blacklight Plantern (does not affect flying zombies).

name: Beacon-shroom
description: When dealing damage, increases the Freeze duration of already frozen zombies by 0.4s.

name: Triplantern
description: Anti-ground Lumos rays (such as from Lumos Cactus and Ray-shroom) that pass through Triplantern will create two additional lasers in the same lane, each dealing 30 damage.

name: Thorn-nut
description:
Reflects 50 damage to zombies biting it.
Can pop Balloons

name: Saguro-shroom
description: Click to switch damage modes

name: Doom Cactus
description:
Each attack has 0% change to unleash an ultimate attack, increasing by 5% each fail.
Ultimate attack shoots a large number of thorns forward, which can hit airborne units.

name: Urchin-shroom
description: Targets flying zombies.

name: Lumos Cactus
description:
At 1 Lumos Level, Pierce 2 Times.
At 2 Lumos Level, Pierce Infinitely and triple air damage.
At 3 Lumos Level, Base laser damage increased to 40.
Shoots double at flying zombies.

name: Pea Drone
description: If the shooter beneath it attacks faster than once every 1.5s, Pea Drone matches that attack speed.

name: Solar Blover
description:
Upon being placed, spins its leaves and fires two spirals totaling 72 Sun Bullets.
Each bullet drops 5 sun upon hitting a target and can be buffed by Infernowood to deal 40 damage and drop 15 Sun.

name: Cherry Drone
description: Targets a zombie in a 3x5 area every 15s and dive bombs them, causing a cherry explosion in a 1-tile radius.

name: Drone-nut
description:
Absorbs damage for its own tile.
After 10s of no damage taken, it regenerates toughness at a rate of 50/1s

name: Mind-blover
description: Pulls all hypnotized zombies back.

name: Camo-shroom
description: Zombies won't eat (will walk through) hiding Scaredy-type plants in a 3x3 area around teh Camo-shroom.

name: Breeze Blover
description:
Lasts 10s before disappearing.
Converts all snow peas on screen to polar ice peas.

name: Fallout Blover
description:
Last for 10s before disappearing.
Damage is doubled against zombies with the Irradiated debuff.

name: Squash Drone
description: Smashes the zombie below repeatedly.

name: Tide-shroom
description: Dispels fog and push the zombies in its lane to the rightmost column.

name: Glowver
description: Gives 1 Lumos Level for the entire field for 30s.

name: Cactus Drone
description: Only targets flying Enemies.

name: Solarfruit
description:
Click on a Solarfruit to spend 25 Sun and make it shoot 5 100-damage stars in 5 directions.
Shoots automatically every 0.35s if placed in a Starry Pumpkin.

name: Star-nut
description: Fires five stars in all directions when damaged.

name: Twinkle-shroom
description: Effect Rate

name: Starburst-shroom
description: Shoots a Star Cap that pierces twice and deals no damage. Each time it contacts a zombie, it releases 1 star projectil in each of 5 directions, each dealing 20 damage.

name: Zodiac-shroom
description: When bitten, hypnotizes the zombie and disappears, causing it to fire stars in a spiral of 60 volleys (300 total projectiles).

name: Starry-shroom
description: Becomes afraid if there is a zombie in range.

name: Death Star
description: Disappears after 3s and summon a Doom Meteor that deals 1800 area damage on impact and splits into 180 spore stars each dealing 20 damage.

name: Spicy Starfruit
description: After 1 second, releases Jalapeno effect and explodes 25 flaming stars in all directions.

name: Sparkwood
description: Ignites passing star projectiles, adding 20 damage and giving them splash damage.

name: Sea Star
description: Attacks twice when fully grown

name: Starglow
description:
At 1 Lumos Level, Stars can track zombies in the same row.
At 2 Lumos Level, Stars are fire continuously.
At 3 Lumos Level, Stars track all zombies.

name: Starthorn
description:
Tracking.
Can only attack flying enemies.

name: Starblover
description:
Attracts nearby star projectiles. Shoots them as tracking projectiles after 1.5s at 2x speed.
If the stars already have tracking, damage is increased by 50% instead.
20 Stars maximum.

name: Pumpkin Pod
description: If a Pea-family plant is inside, it fires once every 3s, matching that plants projectile count, damage, and type. These shots are considered to be fired by the internal plant.

name: Sunny Pumpkin
description: Gives 50 HP as a Shield to all plants in its tile every time she produces Sun. The total Shield value has no upper cap.

name: Cherry Pumpkin
description: Absorbs Cherry explosion damage to restore Toughness.

name: Nut Shell
description:
Spawns a Mini-nut every 50s. When the Mini-nut is fully grown, it is consumed to heal a nearby damaged Pumpkin-type plant for up to 1000 HP or to produce a Wall-nut seed packet if no such plant exists.
A single Nut Shell can produce at most 3 Wall-nut seed packets.

name: Pumpkin Mine
description: Causes single-tiled explosions on damage phase transitions.

name: Chompkin
description:
Generates 1 'Digestive Sac' every 40s, up to a maximum of 3 at the same time. First Digestive Sac takes 7.5s to generate.
Periodically uses a reserve Digestive Sac to help the Chomper plant in the same tile to instantly finish swallowing.

name: Hypno Pumpkin
description:
Has a 1/12 chance to hypnotize a zombie eating him.
Forces up to 1 hypnotized zombie to stay in his tile, using it as a shield.

name: Puff-kin
description:
Starts out at 1/4 max HP.
Restores 50 HP every 3s.
At 1/3 or more of max HP, gains a 50% incoming damage reduction.
At 2/3 max HP or more, absorbs damage for the plant inside.

name: Scareless Pumpkin
description: Scaredy-shroom fusions inside the pumpkin will not be afraid (or self-destruct).

name: Doom Pumpkin
description:
Gains 1% charge every 0.5s. Starting charge is between 80% and 95%.
When charge meter is full (100%), consumes all charges to transform one plant on his tile into a fusion of that plant and Doom-shroom (excluding Odyssey Fusions)

name: Squash Pumpkin
description:
Squash plants inside cannot detect enemies.
When there are Squash or Torchwood plants inside, a baby squash with 225 damage is spawned, disappearing after 6 jumps and regenerating after 3 seconds.
Baby squashes spawned from Squashed Infernowood releases the Jalapeno effect when it lands.

name: Pumpkin Brazier
description: For every 50 peas lit, a Roasted Pumpkin is spawned in front.

name: Sea-shell
description: Can be fed Sea-shroom seed packets to heal by 1/3 max HP (base 1333.3).

name: Jack O' Plantern
description: Gives 1 Lumos Level in a 3x3 Grid. Restores 150 Toughness per Lumos Level every 15s.

name: Thorny Pumpkin
description: Reflects 100% Biting damage back to zombies.

name: Windy Pumpkin
description: Produces a BLover every 30 seconds.

name: Starry Pumpkin
description: Quadruples the storage limit of Starblover (20 -> 80) and Gravitron. (60 -> 240)

name: Solar Magnet
description:
Produces a random metal object every 30s.
Drag a metal object onto itself to produce 25 sun.
Produced object is automatically given to viable magnet fusions if directly in front.

name: Grenadier Magnet
description:
Attracts metal objects and turns them into explosive cherries, up to 5 times before consumption.
Drag metal objects onto the Kaboom Magnet to start an attack manually.

name: Mag-nut
description:
Attracts nearby plant Straight-shooter projectiles, making them orbit at a radius of 1.5 Tiles.
Can hold up to 100 projectiles at once, each lasting up to 20s.

name: Morph-shroom
description: Deals 2x damage to Metal Zombies

name: Hypno Magnet
description:
Uses metal objects to spawn hypnotized zombies with 40% HP.
When bitten, hypnotizes the zombie, then reverts to a regular Magnet-shroom.

name: Dormant-shroom
description: Does not explode, and only serves as an ingredient in other fusions.

name: Anchor-shroom
description:
Magnet interval is 15s, then 10s.
Grows after attracting 3 times.

name: Lumos Magnet
description:
At 0 Lumos Level, 15s Magnet Interval.
At 1 Lumos Level, 11s Magnet Interval and +1 Range.
At 2 Lumos Level, 7.5s Magnet Interval and +2 Range, and damages zombies 200 near the attracted topic.
At 3 Lumos Level, 5s Magnet Interval and +3 Range.

name: Magnethorn
description:
Deals double damage to metalic armor.
Deals 500 damage to Bucknut-copter Zombies.
Dealing a certain amount of damage to Airships can cause it to crash, dealing 1000 damage to zombies near the crash site.

name: Magnet Blover
description: Attracts up to 10 metal objects across the whole field. Takes 1s to process each.

name: Starmorph
description: Deals double damage to iron zombies.

name: Pumpkin Morph
description: Deals 20xAmount of plants in Magnetic system to zombies in vehicles or with magnetable armor, if they are not in the sky or underground.

name: Frost Cattail
description: Deals 2x damage to Chilled zombies.

name: Flame Cattail
description: Deals 3x damage to Enflamed zombies.

name: Solar-pult
description:
Returns 100 Sun upon fusion.
Each shot bounces after hitting a zombie, can bounce once for every 200 Sun.
Each bounce drops 5 Sun.

name: Cabbage-nut
description:
When taking damage, stores 1x the damage taken as a Stored Value. If the damage exceeds 100/500/1000, stores 2x/3x/4x the damage instead.
Stored value is capped at max HP. When Retaliation Meter exceeds 1000, consumes all charges to launch a watermelon dealing the same amount of damage, and gains a shield of equal value that fully decays over 5s.

name: Sprout-pult
description:
Shots bounce twice.
If a shot hits a shrunken zombie, it gains the ability to shrink the next zombies hit.

name: Rebound-shroom
description:
When a lobbed projectile in the same lane hits a zombie in front, it will rebound toward Rebound-shroom and then continue bouncing back and forth between the two.
Only one projectile can be bounced at a time; the bounce height gradually decreases until it hits the ground.
Does not bounce projectiles that can already bounce on their own (like many cabbages).

name: Coldslaw
description: The projectile can bounce once after hitting a frozen zombie, and will increase attack speed for 3s (cooldown 4.5s).

name: Damage-pult
description: When hitting Irradiated zombies, the projectile causes a small splash explosion dealing 1/3rd damage with no falloff.

name: Lettuce-pult
description: Lobs a mini Lettuce-pult that deals AoE crushing damage upon landing, then lobs 2 smaller Lettuce-pults that deal 50% of the original damage before disappearing. The smaller Lettuce-pults lob 2 even smaller Lettuce-pults that deal 25% of the original damage and disappear immediately.

name: Kimchi-pult
description:
On hit, the projectile splits into smaller projectiles across a 3x3 area dealing 1/3rd damage each.
Kimchi-pult Projectiles apply Enflamed before dealing damage.

name: Cherry Pot
description:
Immune to cherry explosions.
Heals the plant on itself when affected by cherry explosions, and also grants a 1s long 30% attack speed boost to cherry shooting plants.

name: Nut Pot
description:
Reduces Incoming damage to the plant on top by 20%.
Immune to Lava tile damage and protects the plant on top.

name: Hypno Pot
description: Grants hypnotized zombies on its tile 33% Damage Reduction and heals 1HP eveyr 0.04s. When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker and reverts back to a Flower Pot.

name: Scaredy Pot
description:
Grants the plant placed on top an attack damage bonus equal to (0.4 x (Plant Sun Cost))%, up to 20%.
If the plant on top is a Scaredy-type mushroom, the attack bonus becomes (2 x ((0.4 x Plant Sun Cost)% + 10%), up to 60%.

name: Ice Pot
description: Transforms Roasted Plants in its tile into its base form. (Cooldown 10s)

name: Spike Pot
description:
Grants 50% damage reduction to Spike-nut and Obsidian Spike-nut on him.
Becomes anti-crush if the plant above is an Obsidian Spike-nut

name: Lumos Pot
description: Dispels a small patch of fog, providing 1 Lumos Level for its tile.

name: Cabbage Pot
description: Grants a 50% attack speed boost to Cabbage-type plants.

name: Butter-nut
description: When bitten, immobilizes the attacking Zombie with Butter for 2s.

name: Baby Corn
description:
Has a 25% chance to throw a butter that deals 40 damage and reduces Toughness by 30%.
Butter instantly kills imps.

name: Blubber-shroom
description:
When damaged or manually tapped, (and if there are zombies within attack range) it performs and attack.
When attacking, loses 30 max HP, throwing one pat of Butter at every zombie in range, dealing 40 damage and immobilizing them for 4s.

name: Cobsicle
description: Has a 25% chance to throw a frozen butter stick that Freezes zombies for 4s.

name: Kernel Morph
description: Has a 25% chance to throw a magnetic butter, dealing 80 damage and stuns the target for 4s.

name: Butter Fly
description: 25% chance to drop butter.

name: Taco-pult
description:
Projectiles bounce once.
Has a 1/4 chance to throw butter, dealing 60 damage and immobilizing zombies for 4 seconds.

name: Butter Pot
description: Raises butter chance from Kernel plants from 1/4 to 1/2.

name: Butternut-pult
description: Has a 25% chance to throw a Butter Squash instead, applying 4s of Butter stun to up to 3 of the damaged targets.

name: Popcorn-pult
description:
Projectiles apply Enflamed debuff before dealing damage.
Upon hitting a zombie with Magma Butter, triggers a full-lane Jalapeno effect with 50 damage, and grants Jalapeno fusions +50% (+25% if odyssey) attack damage for 6s.

name: Butterweed
description:
Deals no damage.
Slows down non-flying zombies that walk over, and butters them it for 1s, every 3s.
No longer pops tires and is ignored by vehicles.

name: Poison Pea
description: Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit. If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet that lasts for 6s, applying 1 Poison value and dealing damage equal to 20x the total projectiles fired in one volley by all Posion-system Straight-shooter plants in its lane per second to all zombies caught within. There can be up to 1 active Toxic Cloud per lane.

name: Poison Repeater
description:
Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit. If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet that lasts for 6s, applying 1 Poison value and dealing damage equal to 20x the total projectiles fired in one volley by all Posion-system Straight-shooter plants in its lane per second to all zombies caught within. There can be up to 1 active Toxic Cloud per lane.
Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.

name: Split Poison
description:
Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit. If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet that lasts for 6s, applying 1 Poison value and dealing damage equal to 20x the total projectiles fired in one volley by all Posion-system Straight-shooter plants in its lane per second to all zombies caught within. There can be up to 1 active Toxic Cloud per lane.
Tap to auto-fuse with a free Peashooter 15s after planting.

name: Gatling Poison
description: Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit. If the zombie hit is already in a Poisoned state, creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet that lasts for 6s, applying 1 Poison value and dealing damage equal to 20x the total projectiles fired in one volley by all Posion-system Straight-shooter plants in its lane per second to all zombies caught within. There can be up to 1 active Toxic Cloud per lane.

name: Foul-nut
description: When bitten, poisons attacker for 10s and gives them 1 Poison point.

name: Foul-shroom
description:
Attack adds one Poison point to zombies.
Forces zombies to switch lanes on bite.

name: Hypno Garlic
description:
Causes hypnotized zombies that touch him to switch lanes.
When bitten, hypnotizes the zombie, forces it to switch lanes, then reverts to a regular garlic.

name: Doom Garlic
description:
Inflicts Irradiated debuff on zombies that bite and curses them. Cursed zombies explode on death in a 3x3 area for 300 damage.
Inflicts 1 Poison point, as well as the poison debuff on zombies that bite it.

name: Stench-spreader
description:
Projectiles add 1 Poison value to zombies on hit.
If the zombie hit is already Poisoned, it creates a Toxic Cloud at the zombie's feet that lasts for 6s, applying 1 Poison value per second to all zombies caught within. There can only be up to 1 Toxic Cloud per lane.

name: Stenchwood
description:
Projectile effects:
Peas: Become Poison Peas and deal +10 damage.
Poison Peas: Become Venom Peas that deal splash damage.

name: Disguster
description:
Inflicts 5 Poison Points to every zombie in the screen and apply the Poisoned debuff.
Increases the time the debuff stays by 5s and forces them to change lanes.

name: Stinky Pumpkin
description: Zombies that bite him will be poisoned for 10s, forced to change lanes, and gain 1 Poison point.

name: Garbage-pult
description:
Projectiles bounce once.
Each time it hits a zombie with Poison points >0, it can bounce again, each hit adding 1 Poison point.

name: Garlic Pot
description:
Reduces biting damage taken by garlic type plants on top.
Has garlic effect on bite.
Forces zombies to move towards the middle row.

name: Clove-pult
description:
Each attack accumulates 1 poison point, applying the poisoned debuff at 5.
Has a 1/4 chance to throw garlic butter with 60 damage, immobilizing zombies for 4s, and forcing a lane switch.

name: Bombrella
description:
Protects plants from catapult projectiles and bungees in a 3x3 area.
Repel approaching zombies with a small-range cherry explosion with a damage of 300.
Immune to cherry projectiles.
For every instance of Cherry-fused defensive plants healing in the surrounding 3x3 area, it gains 1 energy level (max 100).
Bombrella uses 2 levels to absorb any damage in the surrounding 3x3 area.

name: Umbrella Shell
description:
Protects plants from catapult projectiles and bungees in a 3x3 area.
Explosive basketballs deal 100 damage to plant.
Repel approaching zombies, dealing 40 damage.

name: Umbrella Cap
description:
Repels the first zombie on contact, then vanishes. Against shrunken zombies, repels them and loses 50 HP instead.
Spawns a new Umbrella Cap in his tile every 30s.

name: Lumos Umbrella
description:
Protects plants from catapult projectiles and bungees in a 3x3 area.
Explosive basketballs deal 100 damage to plant.
2000 Energy Limit.
Provides 1 Lumos level and dispels fog in the surrounding 3x3 tiles.
Consumes Energy to block projectiles. Each block consumes Energy based on the damage of the projectile.
Restores 25xLumos Level Energy every second, pausing to rest for 5 seconds when completely exhausted.

name: Umbrella Thorn
description:
Protects plants from catapult projectiles and bungees in a 3x3 area.
Explosive basketballs deal 100 damage to plant.
Can shoot down flying zombies and repel airships.

name: Hoverleaf
description:
Protects plants from catapult projectiles and bungees in a 1x1 area.
Explosive basketballs deal 100 damage to plant.

name: Umbrella Kale
description:
Protects plants from catapult projectiles and bungees in a 3x3 area.
Explosive basketballs deal 100 damage to plant.
Prioritized by catapult plants for targeting, increasing damage by 75%.
If there are no zombies in lane, it can store projectiles.
Knocks back zombies, dealing 40 damage, at the cost of Toughness (same rate as umbrella husk).

name: Umbrella Pot
description:
Enhances umbrella-type plants.
Umbrella Husk: +2s immobilization, +50% knockback distance.
Umbrella Rind: Doubles damage of reflected projectiles.
Umbrella Kale: Can attack zombies on adjacent lanes.
Other Umbrellas: Doubles knockback distance.

name: Umbrella Husk
description:
Protects plants from catapult projectiles and bungees in a 3x3 area.
Explosive basketballs deal 100 damage to plant.
Knocks back nearby zombies, immobilizing them for 4s at the cost of Toughness.
1 Zombie = 100 Toughness.
2-4 Zombies = 150 Toughness.
5+ Zombies = 250 Toughness.

name: Umbrella Clove
description:
Protects plants from catapult projectiles and bungees in a 3x3 area.
Explosive basketballs deal 100 damage to plant.
Knocks back zombies, dealing 40 damage, at the cost of Toughness (same rate as umbrella husk).
Forces zombies to change lanes.

name: Marigold Mine
description:
Digs up a treasure every 30s: 1% chance for a random zombie, 10% for a random seed packet, 89% chance for 25 Sun and 100 Coins.
On Beach maps, Marigold Mines placed on Treasure Spots produce 50% faster. 33% chance for a random seed packet, 67% chance for 25 Sun and 100 Coins.
Disapperas after finding 3 seed packets.
On death, triggers a Potato Mien explosion with 1800 damage.

name: Silver Ice-shroom
description: Freezes all zombies for 5s, Chills all zombies for 10s, and deals 20 damage to all non-flying zombies.

name: Silver Doom-shroom
description: Does not explode.

name: Gold Magnet
description: Attracts Straight-shooter projectiles from adjacent lanes and produces 25 coins for every projectile attracted.

name: Silver Kernel
description: Has a 1/4 chance to throw a silver money bag, dealing60 damage and immobilizing the zombie for 4 seconds, and drops 25 coins.

name: Silver Garlic
description: Forces zombies to change lanes on bite.

name: Silver Umbrella
description:
Protects plants from catapult projectiles and bungees in a 3x3 area.
Explosive basketballs deal 100 damage to plant.
Drops 25 Coins each time it activates and knocks back approaching zombies, dealing 40 damage, at the cost of Toughness.

name: Twin Marigold
description:
75% chance to produce 100 Coins.
20% chance to produce 300 Coins.
5% chance to produce 1000 Coins.

name: Melon-nut
description:
When taking damage, stores 1.5x the damage taken as a Stored Value. If the damage exceeds 100/500/1000, stores 3x/4.5x/6x the damage instead.
Stored value is capped at max HP. When Retaliation Meter exceeds 1000, consumes all charges to launch a watermelon dealing the same amount of damage, and gains a shield of equal value that fully decays over 5s.

name: Slice-pult
description: Melon slives no longer do splash damage but deal double damage the damage to shrunken zombies.

name: Spring Melon
description: Charges when not attacking, increasing the damage of the next attack by 60 per second of charging.

name: Hypno Melon
description:
Both direct hits and splash damage have a 25% chance to hypnotize zombies with less than 50% max HP.
When bitten, hypnotizes the attacker, then reverts to a Melon-pult.

name: Winter Melon
description: Deals 5 Cryo points on splash damage.

name: Gourd-pult
description: Projectiles deal area crush damage on landing, then break shortly after, dealing splash damage with fall-off.

name: Melon Shell
description: Each time the catapult plant inside attacks, it simultaneously launches an additional watermelon.

name: Melon Morph
description: Deals 2x damage to zombies with Type 1 Armor.

name: Overripe Melon
description: Fires melon that bounce once.

name: Melon Pot
description:
Returns 150 Sun on fusion.
Doubles splash damage of Melons to 2/3, with no falloff.

name: Cob-pult
description: Has a 1/4 chance to throw a Buttered Corn with 140 damage, immobilizing the main target for 4s and zombies in the splash range for 4s/total splash spread. (minimum of 0.5s)

name: Garlic-pult
description: Accumulates one Poison point for all zombies within the garlic's splash radius. Each Poison point adds 5 damage to splash attacks.

name: Umbrella Rind
description:
Protects plants from catapult projectiles and bungees in a 3x3 area.
Can reflect zombie projectiles back as a melon. Loses 200 Toughness for reflecting projectiles that explode.
Each reflection of projectiles stores energy equal to the projectiles damage, releasing it all on zombies for extra damage when the next knockback occurs.
Knocks back approaching zombies, dealing 80 damage, at the cost of Toughness.

name: Cryo Cannon
description:
Applies Ice shroom effects in blast radius, and valid plants in range get fused with Ice-shroom (Excluding Flower Pots).
Click to aim, then Click to fire.

name: Pyro Cannon
description:
Applies Jalapeno effects in blast radius, and valid plants in range get fused with Jalapeno.
Click to aim, then Click to fire.

name: Spruce Firnace
description: Has traits of Firnace in a 3x3 range. Reverts to regular Firnace after 210 seconds.

name: Saw Firnace
description: Has traits of Firnace in a 3x3 range. Reverts to regular Firnace after 120 seconds.

name: Twin Saw-me-not
description:
The back head targets all zombies on the screen, prioritzing flying zombies.
Gains 5 point of shield every 0.5s, up to 300.

name: Spruce Sawshooter
description:
Immune to Freeze from Snowballs and Blizzards.
Projectiles pierce once, including ice blocks, and leave spinning pine needles on the first zombie hit.

name: Lotus Firnace
description: Has traits of Firnace in a 3x3 range. Reverts to regular Firnace after 60 seconds.

name: Snowbloom Spruce
description:
Immune to Freeze from Snowballs and Blizzards.
Gains 1 ice charge passively every 10s, and from snowball and snow tridents. Gains 60 ice charges when affected by blizzard.
Awakens at 5 charges, firing an ice orb that deals 100 damage with 3x3 splash and inflicts Deep Chill.
While awake, consumes 1 charge per second to heal plants 50 HP in a 3x3 area.

name: Shield Lotus
description: Inherits Snow Lotus traits. Healing also grants 50 points of Shield to each plant.

name: Aloe Firnace
description: Has traits of Firnace in a 3x3 range. Reverts to regular Firnace after 90 seconds.

name: Spruce Sprayshooter
description:
Immune to Freeze from Snowballs and Blizzards.
Gains 1 ice charge from snowball and snow tridents, and 15 ice charges when affected by blizzard.
Uses 1 ice charge to shoot an ice block with double the damage that inflicts Deep Chill and adds 40 Cryo points, dealing x4 damage to Frozen zombies.

name: Soak-me-not
description:
Immune to Freeze from Snowballs and Blizzards.
Gains 1 ice charge from snowball and snow tridents, and 15 ice charges when affected by blizzard.
With ice charges, attacks deal double damage, inflict Deep Chill, and add 1 Cryo Point, but have a 1/15 chance to use up a charge.

name: Aloe Alba
description:
Immune to Silence and Freeze.
Gains 1 ice charge passively every 5s, from snowball and snow tridents, 15 ice charges when affected by ice-shrooms, and 60 ice charges when affected by bilzzard.
Every 5s, consumes 5 charges to heal all plants in a 3x3 area for 50hp and boost their attack speed by 30% for 5s.

name: Bamboo Firnace
description: Has traits of Firnace in a 3x3 range. Reverts to regular Firnace after 60 seconds.

name: Bamblade
description: Same as Bamblock, but Generates 60 points of Shield every 1.5s. (Capped up to Max HP + 60)

name: Bamboo Shooter
description:
Immune to Freeze from Snowballs and Blizzards.
Shots pierce like Spruce Sharpshooter's.
If HP is higher than a hit zombie, deal damage equal to the zombie's health to the zombie and itself. If HP is lower, HP is reduced to 300 and the zombie takes the difference..

name: Bamblotus
description:
Immune to Freeze from Snowballs and Blizzards.
Heals itself by 50 when charged
Recovers hp at a rate of 40/1.5s, increasing by +100% per each adjacent Bamblock plant/fusion.
Incoming damage is divided by 'resilience' (default 1), increasing by 0.3 for each adjacent Bamblock plant/fusion.

name: Bambloe
description:
Immune to Freeze from Snowballs and Blizzards.
Gains ice charges as Aloe Aqua.
Incoming damage is divided by 'resilience' (default 1).
Resilience is increased by 2 for every 1 charge consumed, and increased by 1 when fighting Chilled/frozen zombies.

name: Atlantis Ballista
description:
Immune to Freeze from Snowballs and Blizzards.
Fires 4 bolts in quick succession before resting for 3s.
90% chance to fire Tidal Bolts, which apply soaked for 5s. Soaked zombies will be frozen instead of Chilled when hit by cryo attacks.
10% to fire ice bolts, applying deep Chill.

name: Buckshooter
description: Projectiles knock back zombies and instantly break Handheld Armor.

name: Buck-shroom
description: Projectiles knock back zombies and instantly break Handheld Armor.

name: Rust-shroom
description: Deals 3x damage to non-Handheld Armor.

name: Doomplate-shroom
description: Every zombie killed in its explosion drops a Bucket.

name: Iron Squash
description: Can be fed metal objects to restore 500 Toughness.

name: Iron Star
description: Instantly break Handheld Armor.

name: Bolt-pult
description: Has a 1/4 chance to throw an Iron butter with 100 damage, which stuns the target for 4 seconds and removes non-handheld armor instantly.

name: Metal-pult
description: Deals 2x damage to non-Handheld Armor.

name: Golden Sunflower
description:
Every 10s, 50 Sun is accumulated in storage, up to 10,000.
Ultimate: Releases Sun.

name: Golden-nut
description: Ultimate (5s Cooldown): Increased max Toughness by 1000 and restores to max HP.

name: Golden Ice-shroom
description:
Ultimate (2s Cooldown): Fires an icicle and additionally deals damage in a 2.2-tile range (5x5 area) and reduces all target's Cryo Point cap by 100. This Triggers (up to) 4 times.
Icicles deal 2x damage to Chilled zombies and 4x damage to frozen zombies.

name: Golden Doom-shroom
description: Ultimate (30s Cooldown): Releases a Doom-shroom effect that does not leave a crater.

name: Golden Cabbage
description:
Ultimate (2s Cooldown): Launches cabbages at all zombies, instantly killing zombies with Toughness below 300.
Upgrade Cost is 1000 coins.

name: Golden Pot
description:
When you trigger an ultimate of a Golden Plant above it, all Golden Plants on other Golden Pots with an equal or less ultimate cost trigger too.
Upgrade cost is 2000 coins, doubling per each existing Golden Pot.

name: Golden Kernel
description:
Has a 1/4 chance to throw a money bag dealing 80 damage and stunning zombies for 4s, also dropping 100 coins.
Ultimate (Cooldown 2s): Launches for golden corn bombs, each dealing 450 damage in a 3x3 area without damage falloff.

name: Golden Garlic
description: Ultimate (2s Cooldown): Forces all zombies in its lane to change lanes.

name: Golden Umbrella
description:
Drops 50 Coins each time it deflects a basketball. Knocks back approaching zombies, dealing 40 damage at the cost of Toughness.
Ultimate (7.5s Cooldown): Knocks back all nearby zombies, drops 25 Coins/zombie, restores 1000 Toughness, kills airborne imps, and drops 3 diamonds.

name: Golden Melon
description: Ultimate (2s Cooldown): Launches 60 golden melons, each dealing 120 damage, landing randomly across the screen.

name: Doombox-shroom
description: Every zombie killed creates a 3x3 Jack-in-the-Box explosion that deals 1800 damage at its position.

name: Jokestar
description: Stars explode to deal a small no-falloff splash damage upon contact.

name: Joker Pumpkin
description: Nullifies Jack-in-the-Box explosion damage, protecting the plant inside.

name: Starpick
description: Cannot be attacked and does not not block zombies.

name: Miner Pumpkin
description: Forces Digger Zombies to unearth prematurely

name: Football-nut
description:
Recovers 500 Toughness when fed metal objects.
Takes half of the damage from explosive damage.

name: Chrono Pea
description: Attacks apply chronoshift for 1.5s, or extend the duration by 1 second.

name: Chrono-nut
description:
Chance to teleport biters to the far right of the screen (10s cooldown).
When taking lethal damage, rewinds HP to 3 seconds ago and becomes invulnerable for 3 seconds once.

name: Doomwarp-shroom
description: Inherits the traits of a Doom-shroom. Explosion reduces the countdown of zombies with chronoshift by 30s.

name: Portal-pult
description:
Has a 1/4 chance to throw a neutron butter with 100 damage, which generates a mini black hole when it hits.
The mini black hole massively slows zombies down and explodes after 2s, causing 100 damage and reduce the countdown of zombies with the chronoshift effect by 30s.

name: Chrono Melon
description:
Splash damage is equal to main damage and has no falloff.
If a Zombie hit or in splash radius has Chronoshift effect, up to 3 (6 if on melon pot), will also be afflicted with the effect.

name: Mecha-nut
description:
Changes to Jalapeno Mecha-nut or an Ice-shroom Mecha-nut, healing 3000 Toughness, and triggering the associated affect.
Absorbs double damage from plants in a 3x3 radius.
Can be fed Mecha Fragments to restore toughness, up to 32000.
Resotres 1000 Toughness to each Mecha-nut when zombie drops (items) disappear. (Does not happen if Giga Mecha-nuts are present.)

name: Giga Mecha-nut
description:
When metal items disappear, restores 8000 Toughness to all Giga Mecha-nuts on the field.
Can add 8000 Toughness when a Wall-nut is used on it, and summons a Sharkmarine.
Healing can exceed max toughness with no cap.
Resists being crushed.
Damage is capped at 8000 per hit.
Aborbs damage from plants in a 3x3 area.

name: Doom-spore
description: Takes 30s to grow. Once mature, detonates like a doom shroom if a zombie enters his blast radius.

name: Roasted Wall-nut
description: Can be converted to a regular Wall-nut using an Ice Pot.

name: Roasted Squash
description:
Spawned from a Squashed Torchwood every 60 peas lit.
Can be converted to a regular Squash using an Ice Pot.

name: Roasted Kelp
description:
Spawned from a Torch-kelp every 100 peas lit.
Indistinguishable from Tangle Kelp but cannot be fused.

name: Roasted Spikeweed
description:
Spawned from a Torchweed every 100 peas lit.
Indistinguishable from Spikweed but cannot be fused.

name: Roasted Pumpkin
description: Can be converted to a regular Pumpkin using an Ice Pot.

name: Burger Blaster (2-4)
description: Fires random projectiles.

name: Burger Blaster (3-4)
description: Fires random projectiles.

name: Burger Blaster (4-4)
description: Fires random projectiles.

name: Giant Solar-nut
description: Rolls across the lawn.

name: Giant Inferno-nut
description: Rolls across the lawn.

name: Bowling Solar-nut
description: Rolls across the lawn.

name: Bowling Inferno-nut
description: Rolls across the lawn.

name: XXS Pot
description:
Xiaoxiaosu Collab Plant, exclusive to Vasebreaker and Gacha Modes.
Acts as a regular Flower Pot, but boosts the attack damage of the plants in its tile by 10%.

name: Explod-o-shooter
description:
Bullets deal area explosion damage.
Immune to cherry explosions.
Reduces the Recharge for the last Cherry Bomb seed packet used for its fusion by 85%.

name: Chompzilla
description:
Chomping zombies restores 200 Toughness and deals 200 Damage. Spits out rolling zombie parts after that deal 80 damage and pierce infinitely.
Instantly kills unarmored zombies with less than 500 Toughness, restoring 400 Toughness. Also spits out parts that knockback zombies.
Every 40s, the next bite deals 1M damage and restores max HP.
Damage taken per hit is capped at 1/3 Toughness.

name: Charm-shroom
description:
Deals 40 no-falloff damage to orthogonal neighbors. (1-tile in each cardinal direction)
Has a chance to hypnotize zombies with <60% Toughness (Ignoring handheld armor).

name: Doomspike-shroom
description:
Inflicts Chill.
Deals 4x damage to frozen zombies.
Pierces 2 times. Splashes for 10 damage without falloff within the range of 1 tile.

name: Infernowood
description:
Causes Jalapeno effect on death.
Ignites projectiles for the following effects.
- Peas, Potatoes, and Ignited Peas: +40 Damage
Hypno Peas: +30 damage
Blaze Peas: +30 damage, turn into phoenix peas.
- Snow Peas: Turn to regular peas
- Cherries, Bucks, Suns: 4x damage
- Queen Endoflame attacks: +10 sun

name: Hydra Kelp
description:
Kelp shots bounce on contact, dealing 40 damage to nearby zombies when they land. Adds 1 Tangled value on upon contact.
Can drag 3 zombies under the water.

name: Stardrop
description:
Summons a meteor that explodes into stars every 60s cooldown decreased by 5 seconds for every Stardrop in the magnetic system.
Each plant connected to the Magnetic System will increase the damage of stars by 5%, up to 120 total.
At 1 Lumos Level, Stars can track zombies in the same row.
At 2 Lumos Level, Stars are fire continuously.
At 3 Lumos Level, Stars track all zombies.
At 4 Lumos level, summons another meteor with tracking stars and a separate cooldown from the original meteor.

name: Carrier Pumpkin
description:
Always has Cactus Drone Wingman when he appears. Wingman has increased dps and can track onto flying zombies.
Generates a Cactus Drone randomly on top of a 3x3 grid every so often.

name: Salad-pult
description:
42% chance to rapid fire.
Projectiles split into a mix of corn kernels (1/4 chance for butter) and cabbages upon hitting zombies.

name: Alchemist Umbrella
description:
Has traits of both Umbrella Clove and Golden Umbrella.
Ultimate costs 2500 Coins (7.5s cooldown). Ultimate knocks back all nearby zombies, turning zombies with <25% Toughness into silver statues worth 1000 coins and with <10% Toughness worth 3000 coins. Zombies without statues drop Coins directly.
Can also be fused with Golden Garlic + Umbrella.

name: Spruce Supershooter
description:
Immune to Silence and Freeze.
Gains 1 ice charge from snowballs and snow tridents, and 15 ice charges from Ice-shroom effects.
Uses 1 ice charge to shoot spinning cryo needles with double the damage that inflict Deep Chill and adds 1 cryo point, dealing 4x damage to frozen zombies.

name: Firnurse
description:
Inherits traits of Firnace, and does not revert back.
Produces 1 ice charge to Snow plants in range every 3s.
Heals protected plants for 50 HP every 15s.

name: Titan Pea Turret
description:
Fires 3 peas at once. Firing speed increases the longer the turret fires, with 3 stages.
After shooting 100 rounds, attack speed is inreased by 50%.
After shooting 200 rounds, attack speed is increased by another 50% (to 225% total).
Firing speed returns to normal when its attack resets.
Peas may miss Imps due to the turret's height.

name: Jugger-nut
description:
Anti-crush.
Damage received is capped at 1/3 Toughness.
After Damage Cap, damage is reduced by dividing it by (1 + 0.1 * x, where x is the # of defensive plant types on the field)

name: Pumpkin Bunker
description:
Heals when affected by Cherry and Jack-in-the-Box explosions.
Can only be placed on Titan plants, or other two-tile plants (such as Cob Cannon).

name: Chomper Maw
description:
Can swallow alll zombies in a 1.5 tile range, including Gargantuars (unable to swallow other zombies with chomper immunity).
Digestion Time: 8 + 3 logn(Sum of total toughness)s.

name: Melon Mortar
description:
Randomly hits within a 5x3 Grid.
Spawns up to 40 melons with 3x3 splash damage (no falloff.)
Click to aim, then Click to fire.

name: Kraken-shroom
description:
Adds 1 Tangled Value per hit, dealing additional damage based on the Tangle Value.
Repels approaching zombies (single target) and deal 100 damage.

name: Brood-shroom
description: Emits an extra long-ranged spore in 8 directions each attack.

name: Cab-barrage
description:
When attacking, lobs one cabbage at each zombie in the forward area of its lane and the 2 adjacent lanes.
Umbrella Kales or Midas Umbrellas in front of it can also intercept cabbages that would have been thrown to adjacent lanes and boost them.

name: Lumo-sun
description:
Sun-shrooms are converted into Lumo-suns after they have a Lumos Level of at least 1 for 150s. Each additional Lumos Level accelerates the conversion by 100%.
Gains the ability to produce Lumo-sun (worth 20, or 35 when grown up).

name: Lumo-sprite
description:
Lumo-suns are converted into Lumo-sprites after they have a Lumos Level of at least 1 for 150s. Each additional Lumos Level accelerates the conversion by 100%.
Gains a new ability. When a zombie bites a Lumo-sprite, 1 Lumo-sprite starts to follow that zombie (2 if grown up). Each time a followed zombie takes damage, 1 Lumo-sprite flies off and produces a small Lumo-sun. When the zombie dies, all Lumo-sprites following it are released, droppin gan equal number of Lumo-suns. A Zombie can have up to 20 Lumo-sprites following it at once.
Has the ability to produce Lumo-sun (worth 20, or 35 when grown up).

name: Lumo-burst
description:
Lumo-sprites are converted into Lumo-bursts after they have a Lumos Level of at least 1 for 150s. Each additional Lumos Level accelerates the conversion by 100%.
Gains a new ability. When any Lumo-shroom dies, all zombies in a small radius are followed by five Lumo-flies (higher range when grown up). 
When a zombie bites a Lumo-sprite, 1 Lumo-sprite starts to follow that zombie (2 if grown up). Each time a followed zombie takes damage, 1 Lumo-sprite flies off and produces a small Lumo-sun. When the zombie dies, all Lumo-sprites following it are released, droppin gan equal number of Lumo-suns. A Zombie can have up to 20 Lumo-sprites following it at once.
Has the ability to produce Lumo-sun (worth 20, or 35 when grown up).

name: Football Gatling
description:
Projectiles knock back zombies and instantly break Type 2 armor.
Every 12th shot is a Football Pea that causes hit Football and Football-nut Zombies (no variants) to run away from your house.

name: Football-shroom
description: Deals damage to the armor and zombie at the same time.

name: Snipea-shroom Squad
description:
While split, every 6th shot is a headshot, dealing 1M damage.
While merged attacks to AoE in a 1-tile radius.
Swaps between merged and split every 15s.

name: Berserker Snipea
description:
Unlimited pierce; +1 Doom & Frenzy charge per shot.
Consumes 300 Doom charges to trigger a Doom-shroom blast (72 * Base damage) at the location of the first zombie hit.
Consumes 100 Frenzy charges for double the fire rate, lasting for 8s.
10% chance to crit for 6x the damage. (crit guaranteed against zombies with the Irradiated debuff)

name: Blazer Snipea
description:
Inflicts Enflamed.
Attacks deal 100 damage to nearby zombies.

name: Plaguebringer Snipea
description:
Creates an Infectious Cloud at the target's location. Headshots create a Virulent Cloud instead, which have double the size and attack rate.
The Infectious Clouds move randomly across the lawn and last 15s. Every second, inflict a Garlic Butter and 1 Poison value to zombies inside.
When inflicting Poison value, deal (20x Poison value) as damage. If the target is immune to poison, deals 300 damage instead.
Targets that have lost their heads die instantly, spawning a new Infectious Cloud at their position.
If 30 Infectious Clouds already exist, new ones won't spawn and instead expand the nearest Cloud's radius and increase its damage by 10%.

name: Pea-storm Commando
description: 3% chance to shoot a barrage of peas each attack, lasting 5s.

name: Dynamite Commando
description: 2% chance to shoot a barrage of half-ripe cherries each attack, lasting 5s. These explode instantly and attach a half-ripe cherry to all zombies in the damage radius.

name: Brainstorm Commando
description: 2% chance to shoot a barrage of peas each attack, lasting 5s.

name: Blizzard Commando
description: 3% chance to shoot a barrage of snow peas each attack, lasting 5s.

name: Tri-phoon Commando
description: 6% chance to shoot a barrage of peas each attack, lasting 5s.

name: Gatling Doom
description:
Fires a bullet of doom that deals 1800 damage once every 4 rounds of bullets with splash damage.
Rests for 4.5s after the bullet of doom is shot.

name: Gatling Frenzy-shroom
description:
Each attack will shorten the attack interval by 0.1s (min 0.25s). Explodes when zombies get near.
Fires a bullet of doom that deals 1800 damage once every 16 bullets.

name: SP Gatling Doom
unlock: Automatically unlocked after obtaining Gatling Doom's 2 Modifiers.
description:
Fires Ember Shells that ignore Type 2 armor (handheld) in rounds of 4 and applies Irradiated debuff. Fires an Ultimate Ember Shell once every 4 rounds, then rests for 4.5s.
Ultimate Ember Shells deal splash damage over a large area twice.
Depending on the target's debuffs, gains the following effects on the second explosion triggered by Ultimate Ember Shell:
Chilled: Freezes the target for 1s and deals x4 damage.
Enflamed: Triggers an Enflamed explosion with the damage of the projectile.
Poisoned: Deals extra damage equal to (projectile damage x 0.5 x [Poison value].

name: SP Gatling Frenzy-shroom
unlock: Automatically unlocked after obtaining Gatling Doom's 2 Modifiers.
description:
Can also be fused with Gatling Frenzy-shroom and Doom-shroom.
When frightened, resets attack speed and triggers a craterless Doom-shroom effect, and does NOT self-destruct.
Fires an Ultimate Ember Shell every 16 attacks, then rests for 4.5s.
Depending on the target's debuffs, gains the following effects on the second explosion triggered by Ultimate Ember Shell:
Chilled: Druation increased by 25%.
Enflamed: Damage bonus increased by an additive 40%. (Increases total Enflamed damage with Irradiated buff to 100%).
Poisoned: Triggers Poison effects twice.

name: Gatling Sunburst-shroom
description:
Shots no longer slow but instead drop 5 sun on hitting the 1st and 2nd zombies.
Each subsequent pierce deals 20 more damage but, after the first two hits and if sun is greater than 15k, uses 5 sun per hit.

name: SP Gatling Icicle-shroom
description:
Every 4th shot becomes a Glacial Icicle:
- Against Chilled zombies, applies 4s of Freeze and deals 12x damage.
- Against Frozen zombies, removes Freeze and deals 48x damage.

name: SP Gatling Sunburst-shroom
description:
Shots no longer slow but instead drop 5 sun on hitting the 1st and 2nd zombies.
Each subsequent pierce deals 20 more damage but, after the first two hits and if sun is greater than 15k, uses 5 sun per hit to increase the hit's damage to (1+ hit count)x.
Every 4th shot becomes an Astral Light Cone, which increases sun gain by 1% for 3s and raises the Sun cap by 100 each hit.

name: Ashen Threepeater
description: Ignites the lane upon entry. Otherwise deals no damage.

name: Phoenix Threepeater
description:
Ignites the whole lawn upon entry and death.
Bullets inflict the Enflamed debuff and pierce 2 times.
Damage is doubled after passing through a Infernal Squashwood.

name: Phoenix Drone
description:
Flying plant. Projectiles inflict the Enflamed debuff and pierce 2 times.
On death, triggers Jalapeno effect in the same lane and 2 adjacent lanes.

name: Empress-shroom
description:
Hypnotizes biters up to 5 times.
Every 30s, randomly selects 1 zombie from a specific range to summon.
Instantly summons a zombie when an Enchantress-shroom dies within a 3x3 range.

name: Enchantress-shroom
description:
Same as Empress-shroom, but only summons Gatling Newspaper/Explod-o-rider zombies.
Immediately summons when an Empress-shroom within a 3x3 range dies.

name: Calamity-shroom
description: Hypnotizes zombies in a Doom-shroom's range, and makes them cause a Doom-shroom explosion upon death or leaving the right side of the lane.

name: Avarice-shroom
description:
Summons a mini-boss zombie after it is fused, depending on the scene.
At the same time, summons its ordinary Odyssey variant on the rows.
Defeating the Mini-boss Zombie gives you a ton of Sun, Coins, and points.
Defeating an ordinary Odyssey variant gives you 1 Plant Giftbox.
Can only be summoned once per round. (cannot spawn from Plant Giftbox)

name: Buck-shroom Squad
description:
Machine gun rounds knock back targets and deal additional damage based on the current HP of their Type 2 armor.
The flak cannon targets only air units in its lane, dealing knockback and same-tile splash damage.
The sniper attack shares the same traits as Sniper Pea.

name: Buck-strike Squadron
description:
Clicking the Blover Controller allows deployment of a Buck-strike unit in any chosen tile to its left. Hold Ctrl to deploy all Buck-strike Units simultaneously.
When there are zombies in the chosen tile or its adjacent tiles, the Buck-strike Unit fires small Iron Peas, causing knockback and additional damage equal to the target's Type 2 armor HP.

name: Tesla Magnet
description:
At 0 Lumos Level, 0.5s Magnet Interval.
At 1 Lumos Level, +1 Range.
At 2 Lumos Level, +2 Range, and damages zombies 200 near the attracted topic.
At 3 Lumos Level, +3 Range.
Can pull the pogo sticks from Pogo King Jack-in-the-Boxes and convert them into Jack-in-the-Boxes (item). Also insta-kills Kirov Drones.
Deals 300 Damage every 0.5s to 1 Giga-Trident or Giga-Football-nut Zombie within range.
Launches absorbed metal after 3s, dealing the same damage and AoE as explosive cherries, with full-map targeting.

name: Dyson Magnet
description:
Produces a random metal object every 30s (10s for first production) and recovers 500 HP.
Produces 25 sun when given a metal object.
The Produced metal object will automatically be given to Grenadier, Hypno Magnet, or Charmatron if directly in front.
Metal Production speed is increased by (1 + (0.15 x [Lumos Level]) + (0.05 x [Number of Plants in Magnetic system; limit 4]).
When producing Metal, grants every other plant in its Magnetic SYstem a 3% attack bonus for 30s. If a plant is not at full HP, restores 500 HP for it; otherwise spawns a random metal object at that plant's location. The number of metal objects generated by this effect does not exceed (3 + ([Number of Plants in Magnetic system; limit 4] / 3)).

name: Midas Umbrella
description:
Has the traits of both its ingredients.
Allows projectiles to hit zombies in the two rows below.
Ultimate instantly kills zombies below 50% Toughness

name: Aegis Umbrella
description: Loses the ability to buff lobbed projectiles and attract tridents. Instead, gain 90% Damage Reduction and the ability to reflect bullets from zombies.

name: Obsidian Spikerock
description: Possesses the characteristics of Spikerock. Recovers 500 Toughness every 15s.

name: Obsidian Spike-nut
description:
Reflects damage receives back to the zombie that inflicted.
Can only take 1000 damage at once.
Recovers 1500 Toughness per 15s.
Can puncture tires, dealing 50% of the maximum Toughness to the vehicle zombie and replling them.

name: Omni Pumpkin
description:
Immune to Jack-in-the-Box explosions.
Allows Digger Zombies to come out of the ground early.

name: Quasar
description:
Cannot be targeted by zombies and is ignored by zombies, immune to crush.
Immune to Jack-in-the-Box explosions.
Allows Digger Zombies to come out of the ground early.
Magnetars within the same Magnetic System as a Quasar fire one additional Quasar projectile when attacking, dealing damage equal to the Quasar's attack power.
When fused with a Pumpkin with a plant inside, drops as a seed packet.

name: Grim Arbiter
description:
Does not target zombies.
If there is a plant in the tile in front, it is destroyed with a 50% chance to drop its seed packet. If the plant is cursed, the chance is guaranteed and the curse caster loses 15% max HP.

name: Wicked Undertater
description: When triggered, destroys plants in a 3x3 area with a 50% chance to drop the destroyed plants' seed packet, and spawns a Zombei Soul of the highest-HP zombie within his tile. If the plant is cursed, the drop is guaranteed and the curse caster loses 15% max HP. Does not destroy Grim Arbiters, Wicked Undertaters, Endoflames, or Titan Plants.

name: Big Bang Cherry
description:
Explodes into 36 nuclear debris of equal damage, creating a Radiation Zone of the same size as a Doom-shroom explosion.
Only one Radiation Zone can exist at a time. Lasts 7s, dealing (attack x remaining duration) damage every 0.5s; and 3x damage against unarmored zombies.
Nuclear debris pierce twice. On hit, cause Doom-shroom explosion and Cherry Bomb explosion of equal damage.

name: Big Crunch Squash
unlock: Odyssey Mode Modifier; Big Bang Cherry.
description:
Detects zombies 2 tiles to the left and 3 tiles to the right.
On landing, triggers a Doom-shroom explosion with 3600 damage, with the crater remaining at the original tile, and releases a ring of 36 pieces of Nuclear Debris each dealing the same damage and creates a Radiation Zone lasting (7 - (0.25 x (Time on the lawn in seconds)), minimum of 0s.

name: Radiant Pot
description:
Inherits traits from Golden Pot. Produces 50 Sun and 100 Coins every  n=(Current Sun/1000s). 'n' is minimum 3s and maximum 15s.
Becomes a Radiant Pad when placed on Water (reversible).
Can be shoveled into a Radiant Pad and vice versa.

name: Radiant Pad
description:
This item is not fused, and is rather created when a Radiant Pot is placed on Water (reversible).
Can be shoveled into a Radiant Pot and vice versa.

name: Tycoonwood
description:
Convert all ordinary Straight-shooter bullets encountered into 2 Silver Coins and 1 Gold Coin.
Gold Coins will move in a straight line, while Silver coins will split to the top and bottom rows initially then back to the middle row after 0.8s.
Silver Coins deal 100% of the original bullet's damage, Gold Coins do 200% of the original bullets damage.

name: Magnate Plantern
description:
When targeted by an Apeacalypse Railgun, splits the beam forward into three Gold Lasers at 0° and ±10°, which drop 50 coins per zombie hit.
Can receive Lumos energy from Photon Splitters, up to 1000. When a Photon Splitter in a 3x3 area attacks, Magnate Plantern consumes (current energy/10 + 1) energy, each point increasing the Photon Splitter's damage by 1%.
Each Lumos level increases the damage of both lasers above by an additional 0.1x.

name: Twin Solar-nut
description:
Tapping on this plant:
Spends 500 Sun.
Restores his Toughness to full.
Summons a Giant Solar-nut 1 tile ahead.
Improves an existing Giant Solar-nut by enlarging its size, knockback, and damage (diminishing returns, down to 60%).
After not tapping for 1s, the existing Giant Solar-nut will roll forward, crushing and knocking back zombies, Damage per 0.02s is 600/1200/1644 for 1/2/3 taps respectively. Also drops 15 sun each time it hits a new zombie.
Regardless of the damage type, each damage it receives will reduce a set 50 Toughness and produce 50 sun.

name: Twin Inferno-nut
description:
When taking non-crushing damage, can consume 15 Sun to negate the damage and gain 50 HP.
Reflects 20 damage when bitten and applies Enflamed debuff.
Gains 3000 HP when affected by Jalapeno, including on-fusion.
HP can exceed Toughness with no upper limit, excess decaying at a rate of (10% of Total HP / 1s).
Click to spend 500 health to spawn 1 Giant Inferno-nut in the tile in front. It begins rolling 1s after the most recent click.
