Before it rolls off, further click increase the existing Giant Inferno-nut's size and damage. Damage per 0.02s is 600/1200/1644 for 1/2/3 taps respectively. The Giant Inferno-nut does 2x damage to Enflamed zombies.

name: Epic Twin Solar-nut
unlock: Automatically unlocked after obtaining Twin Solar-nut's 2 Modifiers.
description:
Tapping on this plant:
Spends 1250 Sun.
Restores his Toughness to full.
Gains 10 Solar charges.
Spawns 2 Bowling Solar-nuts that roll 45 and 135 degrees forward and ricochet on hit which each deal a one-time 4000 damage and drop 5 sun multiplied by the number of hits so far.
Summons a Giant Solar-nut 1 tile ahead.
Improves an existing Giant Solar-nut by enlarging its size, knockback, and damage (diminishing returns, down to 60%).
After not tapping for 1s, the existing Giant Solar-nut will roll forward, crushing and knocking back zombies.
Damage per 0.02s is 600/1200/1644 for 1/2/3 taps respectively. Also drops 15 sun each time it hits a new zombie.
Gains 1 Solar charge every time your Sun increases.
When Solar charge meter reaches 100, automatically consumes 100 Solar charges to summon a Giant Solar-nut improved 5 times.

name: Epic Twin Inferno-nut
unlock: Automatically unlocked after obtaining Twin Solar-nut's 2 Modifiers.
description:
Can also be fused with Twin Inferno-nut and Wall-nut.
When taking non-crushing damage, can consume 15 Sun to negate the damage and gain 50 HP and 2 Infernal charges.
Reflects 20 damage when bitten and applies Enflamed debuff.
Gains 3000 HP and 10 Infernal charges when affected by Jalapeno, including on-fusion.
HP can exceed Toughness with no upper limit, excess decaying at a rate of (10% of Total HP / 3s).
Click to spend 500 health to gain 10 Infernal charges and spawn 1 Giant Inferno-nut in the tile in front. It begins rolling 1s after the most recent click. Before it rolls off, further click increase the existing Giant Inferno-nut's size and damage. Damage per 0.02s is 600/1200/1644 fpr 1/2/3 taps respectively. The Giant Inferno-nut does 2x damage to Enflamed zombies.
When Infernal charge meter reaches 100, automatically consumes 100 Infernal charge to summon a Giant Inferno-nut improved 5 times.

name: Aristocattail
description: Summons a drone every time a zombie killed. The drone fires 30 nettle spikes that deal 100 damage each.

name: Thunder Bunnyon
description:
Tapping a Thunder Bunnyon designates it as the Team Leader, as indicated by its lightning orb sparkling. Only one Leader can exist at a time, all others are designated as members.
The Team Leader strikes zombies with electricity, arcing up to 5 times to other zombies (the same zombie can become a non-consecutive target too) within a 2.2-tile radius (5x5 area). Arcs deal 50% of the original damage.
Members do not attack, but increase the Leader's attack damage by 1.5x and increase the number of arcs by 3.
When an electric arc kills a zombie, a random Aristocattail on the field summons a drone that fires 20 bullets dealing 160 damage.

name: Pharos Umbrella
description:
Has all traits of Lumos umbrella, with a Energy limit of 2000.
Fires lasers to attack zombies, dealing 100% of damage/1s.
Prioritizes zombies in the sky and deals 3x damage to air targets. Can attack up to 4 zombies at a time.
When plants are in a 3x3 range, Energy will be consumed to heal the plants. Each treatment consumes 200 Energy Points. Each treatment consumes 200 Energy Points and restores 20% of its max Toughness (max 2000).
Pharos Umbrellas Link with Vertical neighbors, and their detection range expands to the whole screen, and can attack with 2x damage up to 6 zombies.
If exactly 6 zombies are being attacked, a 3x3 explosion will occur at the location of a random zombie every 6s, dealing 300% of attack power.

name: Boreas Umbrella
description:
Prioritizes the nearest zombie in range; can target air units.
Projects a cryo-beam that applies Chill for 5s.
Increases damage by 20 per Lumos Level (max: +200).
Scatter Mode: Can target up to 6 enemies. Gains 1 energy per attack cycle. Switches to Focus Mode at 40 energy.
Focus Mode: Targets only 1 enemy. Consumes 2 energy per attack cycle and multiplies projectile damage by 6. Reverts to Scatter Mode when energy is depleted.

name: Cornveyor Weed
description:
Ignored by vehicles and immune to most types of damage; takes 10 damage when smashed by Gargantuars.
Attack knocks back but no longer pops tires.
Every 3 total hits, applies 1 second of Butter stun to one zombie.

name: Cornposter Pot
description:
Can be reverted to Cornveyor Weed using the shovel.
Increases the butter chance from Kernel-pult plants on it from 25% to 50%.
Can generate mini Butter Squashes (only one can exist at a time for each Cornposter) that leap towards the nearest zombie (up to 1.5 tiles) applying a 1s butter stun to each crushed zombie. It can bounce up to 6 times before disappearing.

name: Dragonbreath Torcher
description:
Breathes fire every 4s that covers a 5-tile range, dealing fire damage to all zombies in range (including aerial) and knocking them back every 0.02s, and generating a small cherry explosion every 0.2s.
When it stops using fire breath, Dragonbreath Torcher will summon a mini flying Bamboom that knocks zombies back and triggers a small cherry explosion to every zombie it hits every 0.02s.

name: Gatling Cherrybomber
description: Fires explosive cherries.

name: Cherrybomber Drone
unlock: When Gatling Cherrybomber is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description:
Can be shoveled to revert back to a Gatling Cherrybomber.
If there is a Straight-shooter plant directly below, its attack cooldown synchronizes with that plant.
There can only be (number of lanes*2) Cherrybomber Drones on the lawn at once.

name: Cherrizilla
description:
Can survive a fatal hit, becoming invulnerable at 1hp for 5 seconds. (30s cooldown)
Deals 1000 damage to chomped zombies, and then spits out exploding cherries and heals 1000 HP.
Once every 40s, performs an ultimate move that instantly kills non-miniboss zombies with hp less than (toughness + 500 x (number of past ultimate move count)), restoring 8000 HP and resets invincibility cooldown.
Repels vehicles.
Takes a maximum 1/3 max toughness per hit.
Toughness over 8000 reduces by 800/1s.

name: Garlizilla
unlock: When Cherrizilla is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description:
Same traits as Cherrizilla EXCEPT:
No longer heals from cherry explosions, inherits garlic properties, and shoots projectiles that poison zombies.

name: Doominator
description:
Has a chance to turn zombies with Toughness <50% into hypnotized Frost Tall-nut zombies.
Creates an explosion where the hypnotized zombie is located, dealing 450 damage to nearby zombies (aligned to grid).

name: Thornminator
unlock: When Doominator is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description:
Deals 4x damage to frozen zombies.
Fires Doom-Hypno Ice Spikes.
Attacks pierce infinitely, prioritizing air units.
Unleashes a barrage of projectiles when planted.
Has a chance to turn zombies with Toughness <50% into hypnotized Frost Tall-nut zombies.
Creates an explosion where the hypnotized zombie is located, dealing 450 damage to nearby zombies (aligned to grid).
When planted, scatters up to 80 Doom-Hypno Spikes, targeting both air and ground enemies.

name: Charmatron
description:
Projectiles have 1-tile splash with no falloff.
Zombies cannot eat it, and are hypnotized instead.
Feeding it metal objects grants 1 charge level for 30s (up to 2)
At 1 charge, its fires 2 shots per attack. At 2 charges, 4 shots per attack.
Each plant in the Magnetic System provides a 5% damage boost to its shots.

name: Captivator Pumpkin
unlock: Bought in the Odyssey Shop; Charmatron.
description:
Zombies that try to bite it are hypnotized instead.
Captures 1 non-flying, non-miniboss hypnotized zombie that passes through, preventing it from leaving the tile and having it absorb damage for the Captivator Pumpkin
Deals damage equal to (0.1x max HP) / 1s to the captured hypnotized zombie and gains 4 energy stacks.
When energy stack is at least 0/50/100, Charge Level is at 1/2/3, draining 1/2/2 energy stacks per second respectively. Charge Level 3 is locked behind a Modifier.
At charge level 1/2/3, every 15/10/6s, hypnotizes 1 non-flying, non-miniboss zombie within a 3x3 area. On a successful hypnotization, the plant inside the pumpkin gains a damage boost of (60% x Charge Level) for 1s. Laser Pumpkins in the same Magnetic system resonate and release this effect simultaneously.
While a Charmatron is inside, the Charmatron always benefits from the damage boost of (60% x Charge Level).
Can be converted back to Charmatron using the shovel.

name: Shroomageddon
description:
Only detects zombies in a 5x3 Range.
Sprays spores which explode. An explosion occurs upon death, dealing damage and freezing ALL zombies on the screen.

name: Atomheart Plantern
unlock: When Shroomageddon is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description:
Can target air.
Attacks apply Chill.
Damage increases by 100% x Lumos Level.
'Refracts' passing Titan Apeacalypse Railgun rays into 3 rays with equal damage.
On death, triggers Ice-shroom and grants 10 Lumos level to all plants for 10s.

name: Apeacalypse Minigun
description:
Each attack consumes 10% of current HP, but will not reduce HP below 500. If at or less than 500 HP, 500 Energy is gained instead.
Whenever any plant's HP changes, gain energy equal to the amount changed.
The damage of a bullet = (Base Attack Power) x (1 + (2 x (Energy / 150k))).
At 50k and 100k Energy, firerate and projectile speed is increased to 1.5x and 2x respectively.
Consumes 150k Energy to release an Ultimate Move. While firing, also releases 4 waves of Frostflame:
Each wave hits zombies in a 30° cone 7 times, dealing (36 x Attack Power).
Between waves, triggers a muzzle burst: Alternating between a Jalapeno effect with (18 x Attacak Power, ignoring DR) and an Ice-shroom effect, and heals plants in its lane for 1000 HP.

name: Apeacalypse Railgun
unlock: When Apeacalypse Minigun is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description:
If Toughness is greater than 500, each attack consumes 100 Toughness.
Other plants cannot absorb damage for Apeacalypes Railgun.
Attack power scales linearly as Toughness drops, up to a max of 900.
Click on the plant to prioritize targetting an Atomheart Plantern or Magnate Plantern within a 60° sector. Lasers gain buffs when passing through them.
Atomheart Plantern: Refracts rays into 3 rays with equal damage.
Magnate Plantern: Refracts rays into 3 Gold Lasers with at 0°, +10°, and -10°, which drop 50 coins per zombie hit.

name: Infernal Squashwood
description:
Inherits Infernowood's traits, but does not burn zombies.
Cherry bomb bullets that pass through it become bouncing spicy squashes that explode every bounce.
For every 21 projectiles ignited, spawns a Spicy Squash.

name: Infernal Sparkwood
unlock: When Infernal Squashwood is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description:
No longer spawns Spicy Squashes. Instead, every 51 projectiles affected spawns a Spicy Starfruit in front.
Ignites most star projectiles for 2x damage, but with original traits removed (except Magnetar stars), granting global homing and anti-air priority.
Explosive cherries become Explod-o-Stars: 2x damage, global homing with anti-air priority.
Affects all other projectiles like Infernal Squashwood.
Triggers Jalapeno effect on death.

name: Princess Solarnova
description:
Generates Sun and consumes nearby plant projectiles to absorb energy (1 damage per energy). Energy is capped at 4x Attack damage.
Excess energy is converted to Sun (1 Projectile per 5 sun).
When energy exceeds Attack damage, fires a solar shot that explodes on impact, dealing 100% in a small area.
Using a Coffee Bean toggles active/inactive modes. Does not attack in inactive mode.

name: Obsidian Tall-nut
description:
Restores 1500 Toughness every 15s.
Resists being crushed by vehicles, taking a maximum of 200 damage each time.
When one Obsidian Tall-nut receives damage, it is shared and divided among all Obsidian Tall-nuts on the lawn.
Blocks Balloon Zombies from passing, forcing them into the ground.

name: Obsidian Mine
unlock: When Obsidian Tall-nut is bought from the Odyssey Shop.
description:
Blocks Digger Zombies.
Releases a small potato explosion for every 1000 damage received (before damage reduction), dealing 500 damage to zombies in a small area.

name: Magnetar
description:
+20 Damage per Lumos Level.
+5% Damage per Magnetic Plant. (capped 300)
Summons a meteor every 15s, dealing 1800 damage upon impact. Splits into multiple stars that home in on zombies and deal 100 damage each. Inherits aircraft-downing ability from Magnethorn.

name: Pulsar
unlock: When Magnetar is bought in the Odyssey shop.
description:
Inherits traits from Starblover.
Storage limit 60.
Acceleration time 1.5s.
Damage 3x.
Projectile speed 2x.

name: Laser Pumpkin
description:
Always has a Laser Drone wingman with him when he appears. Generates a Laser Drone on top of a tile around a 3x3 area regularly.
When part of a Magnetic System with any Metal Pumpkin fusion, gains their special traits (Does not include Blast Pumpkin or Cherry immunity from Pumpkin Bunker).
Transforms one Omni Pumpkin into a Laser Pumpkin every 30s until there is only one Omni Pumpkin.

name: Blast Pumpkin
unlock: When Laser Pumpkin is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description:
Inherits traits from Laser Pumpkin, but no longer spawns Laser Drones or assimilates Omni Pumpkins.
Spawns self-destruction drones every 30s that seek out zombies and explode like a Cherry Bomb.
Aborbs the damage from cherry explosions to heal from them.

name: Napalm-shroom
description:
Each melon creates an inferno zone that lasts 2.5s.
After launching a Napalm Melon, rests for 1.5s, then charges up for at least 6s
.Attacks pierce all armor and split into 2 additional Napalm melons that target nearby zombies with the same damage.

name: Helios Cabbage
description:
Each shot bounces once after hitting a zombie. For every 200 Sun, it can bounce onemore time. Each bounce drosp 5 Sun.
Summons a Mini Sun every 30s that lasts 15s and deals 30+(30 x Amount of Helios Cabbages) damages to all zombies every 0.5s.
When the total amount of Sun is higher than 15k, consume 200 Sun to inflict triple the damage each time the mini sun damages zombies.
When the mini Sun is present, the drop rate of Sun is increased, meteor damage is buffed by 20, and drop 250 Sun on landing.
Ultimate (2s cooldown): Spawns a Mini Sun, or extends the duration of the Mini Sun by 15s.

name: Selene Cabbage
unlock: When Helios Cabbage is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description:
Projectiles +100 Damage per Lumos Level (max +500).
Summons a Mini Moon every 30s. The Mini Moon lasts for 15s and heals all plants for 50x(# of Selene Cabbages). This effect is doubled if a Mini Sun is also present, and additionally tripled on the plant with the lowest HP percentage.

name: Wither-pult
description: 42% chance of rapidfiring. Has an equal chance to spread-fire in a number equal to the number of zombies in its lane. Projectiles split into Garlic Cabbage, Garlic Kernel (25% chance for Garlic Butter), and Garlic Melon upon impact.

name: Litter-pult
unlock: When Wither-pult is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description:
Inherits 42% rapid-fire and spread-fire chances from Wither-pult.
Projectils no longer do splash damage.
Projectiles split into Mini Garlic-Cabbage, Mini Garlic-Kernel (25% chance for Mini Garlic-Butter), and a Garlic-Melon Slice.
These mini projectiles are the same as their non-garlic mini counterparts, and each grants 1 Poison point, boosting damage by 5x Poison points.

name: Cob-literator
description:
Infuses all plants in Main Blast radius with Ice-shroom (prioritized)/Doom-shroom.
Only Side Cannon inflicts Chill.

name: Panmelonium
unlock: When Cob-literator is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description:
Switching Subspecies resets arming time to 36s.
Both Oblivion Clusterbombs and Minishells apply Freeze for 5s before dealing damage, and permanently reduce a zombies speed by 0.5%, up to 90%.

name: Vulcannon
description:
Infuses all plants in Main Blast radius with Cherry Bomb (prioritized)/Jalapeno. Does not affect Pumpkins and Flower Pots.
Blasts apply Enflamed BEFORE doing damage.
Blasts split into multiple volcanic bombs on impact, the amount increasing with more zombies hit.
Volcanic bombs deal splash damage at half the power of the main blast.

name: Kaledera Eruptor
description:
Switching Subspecies resets arming time to 36s.
When attacking, lobs one Pyro Cabbage at each zombie in the forward area of its lane and the 2 adjacent lanes.
Pyro Cabbages apply Enflamed on hit, then trigger an "Explosive Cherry" explosion with a 1-tile radius.
Umbrella Kales or Midas Umbrellas in front of it can also intercept Pyro Cabbages that would have been thrown to adjacent lanes and boost them.

name: Lifereaver Spruce
description:
Gains 1 ice charges from snowballs and snow tridents, 15 from Ice-shroom, and 60 from blizzards.
Fires a Boreal Reaper Saw every 1.5s that becomes a homing shot on hit, with each attack granting 1 ice charge.
When ice charges > 50, Depeltes to 0 every 5s to heal all plants in a 3x3 area from (ice charge/number of plants)x((0.3xShield) + (0.6XxHP)).

name: Soulrender Bamboo
unlock: When Lifereaver Spruce is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description:
Other plants cannot absorb damage for Soulrender Bamboo.
Immune to crush, knockback, and Freeze from Snowballs or Blizzards. Restores 1% max HP when hit by Snowball, Snow Fork, or Blizzard effects.
When HP/Shield is below 1x Toughness, restores 10% Toughness per 1.5s and gains a Shield equal to 10% toughness. On contact with zombies with less then 10x its own HP, dealts 10x Soulrender Bamboo's HP and takes 1x its own HP as self-damage.
Records incoming damage. While recorded damage is greater than 0, takes 1% Toughness damage every 0.02s and deducts the same amount from the record. If recorded damage is greater than 1 Million, this damage is increased. Ice-shroom effect clear the record.

name: Tyrannoflora Lux
description:
Each Lumos level reduces digestion time by 10s (min 5s).
Digestion time is calculated as 5 + (Toughness of all Zombies)^0.33s.
Anti crush.
Can swallow all non-miniboss zombies in a 1.5 tile range.
Using a Chomper seed packet reduces digest time by 10s.
Upon succesfull digestion, pulls nearby zombies from adjacent lanes into its lane and heals max Toughness.

name: Kelptain Goldbeard
description:
Retains all traits of Krakerberus, but can drag zombies underwater an infinite amount of times (up to /1s)
Zombies hit by projectiles turn golden, and grant 3x Odyssey points per game (total 2000 max bonus.)

name: Quantum McCornics
description:
75% chance to launch Mini Butter, shrinking non-miniboss zombies' size and HP to 70%. If shrinking fails, the target is stunned for 1.5s.
Instantly kills imp-class zombies.
25% chance to launch an Ultimate Black Hole that lasts 2s, slows naerby zombies, and absorbs its projectiles in a 3x3 area.
Each bullet absorbed adds 2s to its duration, up to 75s. When it vanished, it triggers a 3x3 explosion that deals stored damage. If it lasted over 5s, the explosion radius significantly increases.

name: Astro-nut
unlock: When Quantum McCornics is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description:
Anti-crush, and takes no more than 1000 damage per hit.
Rewinds to HP from 3s after taking 4000 damage and becomes invulnerable for 2s.
33% chance to ignore incoming damage. Has a chance to teleport biters to the rightmost tile in its lane. (10s cooldown).
After 30s without taking damage, restores HP to max toughness (if below.)

name: Prometheus Liontail
unlock: Bought in the Odyssey Shop. (River Route)
description:
Attacks home in on targets across the screen and prioritize flying zombies.
Attacks inflict Enflamed and then cause single-target knockback and explosive cherry explosions.
Gains 1 energy stack per round if attacking.Gains 60 HP and energy stacks when affected by Jalapeno or Cherry Bomb.
At 240 energy, consumes all energy to fire piercing heatbeans with a 30d degree range that deal damage ever 0.15s, each hit applying the same effects as her homing shots but with 6x damage and half knockback. Lasts 3s and cannot gain energy during this time.

name: Maelonstrom
description:
Each direct base attack hit grants 1 energy. When energy exceeds 50, manually click to consume 30 energy and summon a nebula rift. When energy exceeds 100, the nebula rift doubles its projectile output.
There can only be 1 nebula rift active at once. Each lasts 10s, drifting across the screen from left to right and raining down hail-melons.
If the melon hits a zombie already in chronoshift, it applies chronoshift to up to 2 other zombies in the splash area (or 3 if buffed by melon pot), prioritizing non-chronoshifted targets.

name: Fungularity (Level 1)
unlock: When Maelenstrom is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description: Click on it once to target, then click somewhere on the lawn to select target. Explosion releases Doom-shroom effect at the target spot, applies 30s of Chronoshift, temporarily freezes the level (delays the next zombie wave) for 1s, and spawns 5 sets of vertical portals lasting 10s each. Portals fire 1 Ice-particle stream. A Doom-shroom on it increases the level by 1, up to 3. Ice-particle streams deal 10 damage every 0.02s to zombies on contact, apply Chill and 1s of Chronoshift, and increase elapsed Chronoshift time by 1s. Can target air. When they disappear with the portals, deal cremator damage in a 1.5-tile radius and apply 10s of Freeze.

name: Fungularity (Level 2)
unlock: When Maelenstrom is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description: Click on it once to target, then click somewhere on the lawn to select target. Explosion releases Doom-shroom effect at the target spot, applies 30s of Chronoshift, temporarily freezes the level (delays the next zombie wave) for 3s, and spawns 5 sets of vertical portals lasting 10s each. Portals fire 2 Ice-particle streams. A Doom-shroom on it increases the level by 1, up to 3. Ice-particle streams deal 10 damage every 0.02s to zombies on contact, apply Chill and 1s of Chronoshift, and increase elapsed Chronoshift time by 1s. Can target air. When they disappear with the portals, deal cremator damage in a 1.5-tile radius and apply 10s of Freeze.

name: Fungularity (Level 3)
unlock: When Maelenstrom is bought in the Odyssey Shop.
description: Click on it once to target, then click somewhere on the lawn to select target. Explosion releases Doom-shroom effect at the target spot, applies 30s of Chronoshift, temporarily freezes the level (delays the next zombie wave) for 10s, and spawns 5 sets of vertical portals lasting 10s each. Portals fire 5 Ice-particle streams. A Doom-shroom on it increases the level by 1, up to 3. Ice-particle streams deal 10 damage every 0.02s to zombies on contact, apply Chill and 1s of Chronoshift, and increase elapsed Chronoshift time by 1s. Can target air. When they disappear with the portals, deal cremator damage in a 1.5-tile radius and apply 10s of Freeze. Level 3: Explosion damage 3x, 5 Ice-particle stream per portal, and freezes the level for 10s. Additionally deals 10x attack to the zombie with the highest HP at the detonation epicenter tile, returns 1 Maelonstrom seed packet, and is extremely unstable.
